$comment: Copy this file to <repo>/.claude/orchestrate-gates.json (or <repo>/orchestrate-gates.json) and replace the pnpm commands with the repository's own. Every '$comment' key is ignored by the CLI. Commands run with 'bash -c' in the gate cwd; a non-zero exit is a FAIL.
$comment_cachePaths: Deleted before a cold run (the ship gate, or gate run --cold). Patterns never reach into node_modules or .git: a hit under either path component is skipped, so '**/dist' clears package build output but leaves node_modules/<pkg>/dist alone.

sharedCache.note: Workers share the pnpm content-addressable store (pnpm store path), so 'install' in a fresh worktree links instead of downloading. Point PNPM_HOME/pnpm store at one location for every worktree.

unit.$comment: Warm gates, run by the worker and re-run by the dispatcher at Gate 1 inside the unit worktree.
{{baseline}} becomes the --since sha (or the checkpoint baselineSha): only packages changed since the baseline are tested.

integration.$comment: Warm, after each merge into the integration branch.

ship.$comment: The ship stage always runs cold: cachePaths are deleted first.
optional: reported as FAIL when it fails, but the stage still passes.

pricing.$comment: USD per million tokens, e.g. "sonnet": { "inPerMTok": 3, "outPerMTok": 15, "perMTok": 6 }. Fill in the current list prices; until then the empty objects make 'orchestrate cost' print 'USD n/a' (a rate of 0 is treated the same way, never as free). perMTok is a blended rate for dispatches that recorded only a tokens total.
